repositories.name: diagram-design
repositories.description: 29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.
repositories.summary: 为Claude Code等AI编程工具提供29种编辑级HTML+SVG图表类型的技能包，可生成无阴影、非Mermaid风格的静态图表。

repositories.name: semantica
repositories.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repositories.summary: Semantica 是一个开源 Python 框架，用于构建可查询、可审计的上下文知识图谱，以支持 AI 代理的决策记录与追溯。

repositories.name: skills
repositories.summary: Anthropic 官方发布的 Claude Agent Skills 示例仓库，包含多种技能模板与文档处理技能。

repositories.name: needle
repositories.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
repositories.summary: Needle 2 是一个面向工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取的 45M 参数开源模型，整体仅 14MB，可在约 28MB 内存中运行完整会话。

repositories.name: FluidVoice
repositories.description: Fastest and only macOS Dictation app with on-device STT and custom trained AI enhancement model. A local Wispr Flow alternative. ⭐ helps a ton :) Windows & iOS waitlist open. Linux soon.
repositories.summary: FluidVoice 是一款开源的 macOS 语音转文字听写应用，支持设备端 AI 增强、命令模式和写作模式，可离线运行。

repositories.name: unsloth
repositories.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repositories.summary: Unsloth 是一个本地运行的桌面应用，用于运行和训练大语言模型及扩散模型，支持多种模型类型，并提供微调、部署等功能。

repositories.name: macro
repositories.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
repositories.summary: Macro 是一个用 Rust 开发的开源一体化团队工作空间，整合邮件、聊天、文档、任务、CRM 与 AI 代理，并通过共享记忆和 @ 链接实现统一协作。

repositories.name: holehe
repositories.description: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.
repositories.summary: holehe 是一个 Python 工具，通过检查邮箱在 Twitter、Instagram 等网站是否注册，利用忘记密码功能获取相关信息。

repositories.name: spiderfoot
repositories.description: SpiderFoot automates OSINT for threat intelligence and mapping your attack surface.
repositories.summary: SpiderFoot 是一个开源情报自动化工具，集成超过200个数据源，用于威胁情报收集和攻击面测绘，支持Web界面和命令行操作。

repositories.name: Switchyard
repositories.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
repositories.summary: Switchyard 是一个用 Rust 编写的 LLM 流量代理和库，用于在多个模型后端间路由请求，并转换 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 等 API 格式。

repositories.name: holaOS
repositories.description: Open-source All in One AI agent workspace. Run any agent — Claude Code, Codex — across your tools (100+ integrations + MCP), apps, browser, and files, with shared memory. Built-in models or BYOK.
repositories.summary: holaOS 是一个开源的一体化 AI 智能体工作台，可在统一界面中运行 Claude Code、Codex 等智能体，并集成多种工具、应用、浏览器和文件，支持共享记忆与自带模型。

repositories.name: obsidian-skills
repositories.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
repositories.summary: 为 Obsidian 提供代理技能，让 AI 助手通过 CLI 和开放格式创建、编辑 Markdown、Bases 与 JSON Canvas 文件。

repositories.name: manim
repositories.description: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
repositories.summary: Manim 是用于创建精确数学动画的 Python 引擎，由 3Blue1Brown 作者开发，支持编程式动画制作。

repositories.name: agency-agents
repositories.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repositories.summary: 一个提供多种专业AI代理角色配置的集合，可通过脚本或桌面应用安装到Claude Code等AI编程工具中。

repositories.name: LTX-2
repositories.description: Official Python inference and LoRA trainer package for the LTX-2 audio–video generative model.
repositories.summary: LTX-2 是首个基于 DiT 的音频-视频生成基础模型，提供同步音视频生成、高保真输出及多种性能模式，并附带官方 Python 推理与 LoRA 训练工具包。

repositories.name: modly
repositories.description: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
repositories.summary: Modly 是一款本地开源桌面应用，利用 GPU 上的 AI 模型将照片转换为 3D 网格模型。

repositories.name: ragflow
repositories.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
repositories.summary: RAGFlow 是一个开源检索增强生成引擎，结合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为大型语言模型提供上下文层，支持深度文档理解与精准引用。
